integrity: Exact enumeration of 51840 Weyl elements was reproduced from the standalone Python checker. Group-theoretic and geometric arguments are written out. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The spectrum is for the universal Weyl action, not fixed-q surface frequencies; the quarter proportion is asymptotic. All-q degree-five sharpness is proved for q >= 4. Older unindexed permutation tables may contain equivalent results.
title: Steiner-pair descent on cubic surfaces: a sharp degree-five bound and a quarter-density tritangent obstruction
